intended_object: A large integer base τ used inside a computational certificate for the Sendov conjecture in degrees 80–100. Recurrence rows evaluated at `betac` are packed into one integer exponentiation in base τ. This is taken from the docstring and the module context.
explanation: This is a hard-coded numeric constant. It exists only so that a certificate can be checked by computation: it packs several integer entries into one number for fast kernel or `decide` evaluation. The docstring says what it is for (it is larger than twice the absolute value of every row entry), but it is an implementation detail of a proof and has no standard mathematical counterpart. So `not_a_mathematical_object` is the right verdict.
